Sam Altman [told TIME](https://time.com/article/2026/08/26/openai-sam-altman-interview/) that OpenAI is "not quite yet" there, but by the end of this year it will have an internal system he would call AGI.

His research chief Mark Chen puts them 80 percent of the way. Greg Brockman went further, saying that looking back from two years out, this may be remembered as the moment AGI was created.

Nvidia's Jensen Huang has been saying we already got there since March.

They're measuring different things. Huang's bar is an AI that can build and run a billion-dollar company, and OpenAI's charter says outperforming humans at most economically valuable work.

The receipt OpenAI points to is Astra. Altman expects it to be the first model that invents new things in a way that matters.

None of this launches soon. It lives inside OpenAI and Nvidia for now.

78082.body:
View this post on the web at https://linas.substack.com/p/fintechpulse1119

Hey Everyone,
Good morning & happy Thursday! Today, we’re breaking down Revolut's EURR euro stablecoin launch to see why the real story here isn't another token but a white-label distribution play (the PayPal/Paxos playbook applied to on-chain euros, who Revolut is actually racing here & why it's not Circle, and what’s next + bonus deep dives into Revolut’s AI Research Lab [ https://substack.com/redirect/becdf9e8-2276-4c9d-828c-8ca8728fe14d?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] and the Ultimate List of Stables Resources [ https://substack.com/redirect/84bf3e34-f7d7-4084-960c-089753e3bbd0?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside), Anthropic's $30 trillion IPO pitch that tops SpaceX's record and runs about 650x the business Anthropic actually operates today (how a private slide from the leaked Coatue deck became a public roadshow number, why the TAM isn't dishonest but has a job to do, & the one tell in the upcoming S-1 to look for + bonus deep dives into The New Enterprise AI Go-To-Market Playbook [ https://substack.com/redirect/107bdd20-bf7b-4783-b05a-e11134e0b0bd?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] & The Age of the One-Person Company [ https://substack.com/redirect/01f03ed9-c115-42d3-b078-153539f294a6?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside), and Stripe's Clerky acquisition (the M&A of the legal OS behind $140B in startup fundraising, why this is a switching-cost play disguised as a tuck-in, the attorney distribution channel Atlas could never build on its own & why Stripe no longer needs to buy Carta to make Carta less inevitable + bonus deep dive into The Complete Guide to YC’s Open-Source AI Agent Harness inside [ https://substack.com/redirect/f6aa1032-6f71-4e44-9e7b-e79913617f86?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside). Let’s jump straight into the fascinating stuff 🌶️
Revolut built EURR stablecoin to own Europe’s euro stables on-ramp 🪙💶
Following the money (or should I say euros?) 💶 Revolut’s [ https://substack.com/redirect/51ad0bca-8175-4856-8b49-724a7328210a?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] new euro stablecoin, EURR, went live this week across Denmark, Poland and Portugal with €369 in reserves and 80 million banking customers on the other side of the funnel.
Doesn’t look promising? Don’t be so quick to judge because the float is just a rounding error here. The distribution pipe is the whole product. Revolut outsourced issuance to Stripe’s [ https://substack.com/redirect/f7671066-8964-41e4-b8d7-0b9f3dd5529c?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] Bridge and kept both the brand and the customer relationship, a white-label split you’ll see more fintechs copy.
